acceptance_criterion: Accept transfer of the frozen E1-based H-CORE baseline to the unmodified E2 core if the three-repeat arithmetic-mean SI_15_60 is between 7.51% and 11.51%, inclusive, corresponding to 9.51% ± the declared 2.00 percentage-point discrimination threshold.
claim_boundary: V4.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime. Its adjudication tests whether a registered hypothesis survives contact with the completed measurement. It is not a contemporaneous pre-experimental record and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.

experiment_card.acceptance_criterion: Matched 15-60 min drift at 120 C stays below 4.75% across at least two repeats, i.e. below half the linear-dilution prediction of 9.51% implied by a reactive mass fraction of 1.0000. This accepts H-RESIN over H-CORE.
experiment_card.falsification_criterion: H-RESIN is falsified if matched 15-60 min drift is at or above the linear-dilution prediction of 9.51%. H-CORE is falsified if drift falls below 4.75%, a separation larger than the 2.00% resolution threshold. H-DUAL is falsified if this acrylic-only composition reaches the low-drift regime with no minor tackifier present.

measurement_plan.name: matched-window 120 C thermal hold
measurement_plan.protocol: Hold the melt at 120 C. Record viscosity at 15, 30, 45 and 60 min. Report the 15-60 min matched-window relative change. Run at least two independent repeats.

falsification_criterion: If the three-repeat arithmetic-mean SI_15_60 is below 7.51%, H-CORE's frozen 9.51% prediction is falsified by a downward deviation exceeding 2.00 percentage points. If it is above 11.51%, the E1-to-E2 baseline-transfer assumption is falsified, although none of H-CORE, H-RESIN, or H-DUAL is directionally falsified under the registry's stated rules. A result from 7.51% through 11.51% falsifies none of the registered hypotheses.
next_experiment_if_falsified: Run S1C49::M-HOLD-120 under the same controlled process block with three independent preparations, using the measured S1C01 mean as the E2-core baseline; verify acrylic reactive-group content before calculating the candidate reactive mass fraction and prospective linear and half-linear thresholds.
primary_observable: Arithmetic mean of SI_15_60 = 100 × (eta_60 - eta_15) / eta_15 across exactly three independently prepared S1C01 repeats at 120 C, with viscosity recorded at 15, 30, 45, and 60 min
rationale: S1C01::M-HOLD-120 directly measures the least-resolved failure-mode coordinate and removes the dominant core-baseline and realization-state ambiguity before testing an acrylic intervention. It is not a mitigation test and cannot adjudicate H-RESIN versus H-DUAL, but it makes the subsequent modifier experiment interpretable without claiming a molecular mechanism.
stage_disagreements_resolved: The Proposer favored S1C49::M-HOLD-120 as an acrylic-only discriminating probe. I followed the Skeptic and Robustness Adjudicator instead because their high-severity objection is design-changing: S1C49 uses the E2 core, but its thresholds are inherited from a single E1 hold despite different core composition and stoichiometry. Without an E2-core hold baseline, an S1C49 result cannot cleanly attribute drift suppression to the acrylic intervention. S1C01 is chosen among the apparently equivalent reactive-core-only cards because the payload identifies it as the first listed unmodified E2-core card.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: The 9.51% E1 reference and 51.54% E5 reference each come from a single hold run, and neither resin-axis contrasts nor an E2 hold baseline have been measured. This experiment closes the E2-baseline gap but provides no direct modifier-axis contrast.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: There is no temperature or time-window extrapolation because the measurement is made directly at 120 C from 15 to 60 min. The remaining extrapolation is chemistry transfer from E1 at NCO:OH 1.7 to the E2 core at NCO:OH 1.8 and a slightly different core composition.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: M-HOLD-120 has a declared 2.00 percentage-point discrimination threshold. The decision statistic is prospectively fixed as the arithmetic mean of exactly three independent SI_15_60 values; individual values must also be retained to expose disagreement.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: E2 static viscosity previously varied by up to 3.57-fold at 120 C, and no repeated E2 hold trajectory exists. Three independently prepared repeats with fully recorded and controlled process histories are therefore required, although relative within-run SI_15_60 may be less sensitive to absolute viscosity-scale displacement.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
